children: Dublin | 16 September 2026: Uniphar plc (the "Company"), was notified by Allianz Global Investors GmbH on 16 September 2026 that, as of 15 September 2026, they have an interest in 10,280,876 ordinary shares of €0.08 each in the capital of the Company ("Ordinary Shares"). This represents 3.96% of the issued Ordinary Shares of the Company*.
* Based on issued share capital figure of 259,574,298 Ordinary Shares
Allan Smylie, Head of Strategy and IR
